meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 做网页或组件前会先定一个鲜明的美学方向，再写出可运行的前端代码，排版、配色、动效都按这个方向打磨，避开千篇一律的 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 构建网页、组件等前端界面，或抱怨设计一股 AI 味时触发；它会先弄清用途、受众与技术限制，再动手写代码。

say.text: 帮我做一个作品集首页，走极简高端路线
say.note: 它会先定美学方向，再写代码

say.text: 用 React 写个定价页组件，别用 Arial 和紫色渐变
say.note: 会换成有特点的字体与配色

say.text: 把这个页面改成深色主题，加上滚动动效
say.note: 动效与主题按原有风格统一

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction, then writes working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) with careful attention to typography, color, motion and layout, avoiding generic AI aesthetics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to build a web page, component or app interface, or when you want to avoid generic AI-looking design. It settles purpose and style before coding.

say_en.text: Build me a minimal, high-end portfolio landing page
say_en.note: It picks an aesthetic direction first

say_en.text: Write a React pricing component—no Arial, no purple gradients
say_en.note: It swaps in distinctive fonts and palette

say_en.text: Rework this page into a dark theme with scroll animations
